code_snippets.parse_list:
async def parse_list(page):
    # 由于无分页，需定位数据容器
    await page.wait_for_selector('CSS_SELECTOR_FOR_DATA_CONTAINER')
    items = await page.query_selector_all('CSS_SELECTOR_FOR_EACH_ITEM')
    for item in items:
        detail_url = await item.eval_on_selector('a', 'el => el.href')
        yield detail_url
code_snippets.parse_detail:
async def parse_detail(page):
    await page.wait_for_selector('CSS_SELECTOR_FOR_TITLE')
    title = await page.text_content('CSS_SELECTOR_FOR_TITLE')
    author = await page.text_content('CSS_SELECTOR_FOR_AUTHOR')
    pdf_link = await page.get_attribute('a[href$=".pdf"]', 'href')
    # 下载文件示例
    if pdf_link:
        await page.goto(pdf_link)
    return {"title": title, "author": author, "pdf_link": pdf_link}
